instruction: `validate` returns the trimmed URL when it is safe to put verbatim in an HTTP Location header, and null otherwise. A URL that is accepted here and then throws at the header is worse than one rejected up front.
provenance: URL shortener build trial, 2026-09-15: two of three frameworks accepted a non-Latin-1 URL with 201 and then returned 500 forever, leaving a permanently dead short code.
